limitations: Route latency p95 (952 ms across all exact routes) exceeds the 750 ms target; dominated by two osascript launches and two provider lookups (M13).
Discovery polling (two inventory calls per 5 s) costs ~5–6 % of one core, above the idle-companion target (M13).
In-place session switches reach the projection within one discovery interval (observed 2.1–2.9 s); routes always perform their own fresh lookup.
Only the native-installer direct CLI profile is qualified; other Claude surfaces (agent view, background jobs, desktop, IDE) are unsupported for exact routing and return INSPECTOR_ONLY.
Fullscreen/Spaces, minimized restoration, Terminal restart and readback-race qualification remain M0C (SPEC §13.3).
redaction: Home paths written as ~; display labels and cwd of the owner's unrelated Claude sessions removed; prompt text and tool payloads are never stored (hook probe keeps only session_id/hook_event_name/source/reason). Full native session IDs of the test sessions are kept for reproducibility. The system-wide tccd stream is trimmed to the relevant windows; the untrimmed capture and the pre-migration journal backup are kept outside the repository.
